_note: Eurocode 2 (EN 1992-1-1) constants. PROVISIONAL — gate G-EC2 (spec §14, plan P4a): every numeric cell awaits ratification by the nominated structural engineer before P4a acceptance. The engine reads this the same way once signed; only the values change. The formulas below are the standard EC2 relations (§7.1–7.8 of the spec are written in EC2 terms).

bendDeduction._note: Geometric model shared with BAEL pack: deduction = filletRadius·(2·tan(θ/2) − θ).

tolerance._note: G-TOL (spec §7.12, §14.8): per-rule WARN band above the minimum, as a fraction. PROVISIONAL.

slab._note: EC2 §9.3.1.1: max bar spacing principal min(3h,400), secondary min(3.5h,450); distribution ≥0.20·As,main.

skin._note: PROVISIONAL side-face (skin) steel (v1.0.5 M4 / V-C, G-EC2): mandatory when h > depthThreshold_mm (EC2 §7.3.3 / §9.2.4 surface reinforcement); per-face min area = minAreaFractionOfSide·(b·h), spacing capped at maxSpacing_mm. Owner/engineer to ratify.

bundle._note: PROVISIONAL bundle limits (v1.0.5 M4 / V-B, G-EC2, §8.9): max bars per bundle (3 at a lap); equivalent-Ø cap drives cover/spacing. Owner/engineer to ratify.

curtailment._note: PROVISIONAL curtailment/anchorage (v1.0.5 M4 / V-E, §7.7 / §9.2.1.3, G-EC2): a curtailed bar must develop l_bd past its cut-off; a bare (none) interior cut cannot. hookedFactor reduces the development past a hooked cut-off. Owner/engineer to ratify.
